name: AiMOGA Argos
summary: A 13.6 kg consumer robot dog with a panoramic camera for companionship, remote video monitoring and carrying up to about 5 kg, with about 2 h of battery.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer: the only listing is Roboter Deutschland, a web shop run from Las Vegas without a named company, and AiMOGA names no EU distributor.

sellers.name: AiMOGA Robotics
sellers.note: Global purchase and distributor forms; showed products at IFA 2026 in Berlin and says it is looking for European partners.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: maker page; the shop lists 13.8 kg

specs.label: Joint motors
specs.conditions: maker page says 12 joint motors; the shop and press say 13 DOF

specs.label: Step height
specs.conditions: the maker page prints 15 cm under the label 'Climbing angle' and 40° under 'Step height'; read by unit

specs.label: Climbing angle
specs.conditions: see step height: labels swapped on the maker page

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: HD panoramic camera, 2 ultrasonic radars (±30°), six-microphone array, LED light

notes: Consumer companion robot (the shop lists its use as 'Verbraucher'); controlled by voice, touch and an app with remote video. No SDK, no LiDAR and no IP rating found.
Maker says gravel, grass, slopes and steps are no obstacle; stairs are not stated.
Short runtime (about 2 h) and small payload: not a site inspection robot.

images.alt: AiMOGA Argos robot dog, white, side view

evidence.task: Walks night patrols with its LED light and sends live video with alerts to the owner's phone
evidence.note: Maker product page claim for home use.

evidence.task: 1,000th Argos delivered; units used in homes, factories and communities for inspections and night patrols with live video
evidence.note: Press report; no named customer or site.

sources.title: Chery's Robot Dog Push Shows Tech Beyond Cars

openQuestions: Is the shop price gross or net, and are shipping, import VAT and duties from outside the EU added?
CE marking, EU warranty and service for Argos in Germany.
Does the shop deliver the base Argos or the newer Argos X2 shown at IFA 2026?
Step height and slope labels are swapped on the maker page; stair climbing is not stated by the maker.

The Roboter Deutschland network also lists robots it cannot back up: its Galbot ET1 page gives specs that contradict Galbot. Treat this shop as an unverified grey-import route until an order is confirmed.
